claude.performance_metric: FY2016 net loss $338M on $636M revenue; $130M impairment; Feb 2016 Chapter 11; ~$2.4bn debt eliminated, existing shareholders no recovery; deregistered 2017
claude.rationale: The slice documents realized product/process (asset/operations) incoherence over time: a portion of the drilling fleet was cold stacked and the filing warned the cold-stacked rigs "will require significant capital investment prior to re-entering service," indicating acquired operating assets could not be productively aligned with operations in the outcome window — supporting p4=1. No evidence speaks to a fracture between operations and the people/management/culture of the organization; the distress is financial/asset-related, so p5 is coded uncertain. The slice provides no documentation of controlling-intent archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility (t1, t2 uncertain), only distress metrics, going-concern doubt, and Chapter 11 with residual indemnity entanglement to the former parent.

gemini.performance_metric: Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing and deregistration; existing shareholders received no recovery
gemini.rationale: The provided slice documents severe financial distress, a Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing, and cold-stacked rigs requiring capital investment. However, it does not document any specific integration failures at the product/process interface (p4) or the process/organization interface (p5).
